name: CAMAROE
recent: Camaroe 与 Huawei Technologies (Malaysia) 及 Sustainno 签署谅解备忘录，计划在养虾场部署可再生能源与智能能源技术。公司董事与大股东在10月初有多笔股权变动申报。最新季度营收环比回升，但仍录得净亏损。
notable: 与 Huawei Technologies (Malaysia) 及 Sustainno 签署谅解备忘录，推动养虾场采用智能能源与可再生能源技术。
董事与大股东在10月初有多笔股权变动申报，涉及间接持股的增持。
risks: 最新季度仍录得净亏损，净利率为负。
营收同比下滑，净亏损同比扩大。
earnings: 截至2026年6月30日季度营收为621万令吉，环比增长23.4%，但同比下滑24.5%；净亏损35.4万令吉，净利率-5.7%，较上季-24.0%收窄，但净亏损同比扩大155.5%。

Camaroe, Sustainno and Huawei Malaysia ink MoU to deploy renewable energy at prawn farms

recent_en: Camaroe signed an MoU with Huawei Technologies (Malaysia) and Sustainno to deploy renewable energy and smart energy technologies at its prawn farms. Directors and substantial shareholders reported several shareholding changes in early October. Latest quarterly revenue rebounded sequentially but the company remained in net loss.
notable_en: Signed an MoU with Huawei Technologies (Malaysia) and Sustainno to drive smart energy and renewable technology adoption at prawn farms.
Several shareholding change filings by directors and substantial shareholders in early October, involving acquisitions of indirect interests.
risks_en: Remained in net loss in the latest quarter with a negative net margin.
Revenue declined year-on-year and net loss widened year-on-year.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was MYR6.21 million, up 23.4% QoQ but down 24.5% YoY; net loss was MYR354,000 with a net margin of -5.7%, narrower than the previous quarter's -24.0% but a 155.5% YoY widening in net loss.
